name: Linux kernel
description: The kernel at the heart of every Linux system.
summary: AI-assisted patches are accepted when the AI use is tagged with Assisted-by and a human reviews the work, signs off and takes full responsibility. AI agents may not sign off or send anything on their own.

evidence.quote: AI agents MUST NOT add Signed-off-by tags. Only humans can legally certify the Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO).
Contributions should include an Assisted-by tag in the following format:
if a tool was used to find a problem addressed by a change, that should be noted in the changelog.
leave the result to the reporter for review (the assistant must never send anything itself)
be transparent about the origin of content in cover letters and changelogs.
The changelog was generated by handing the patch to a generative AI tool and asking it to write the changelog.
